source.title: Semi-Modular Weapons Carrier
source.author: RGriffin65
source.notes: Vehicle rework (LANCE-19 batch 3, 2026-10-31), differs from the mech text above: no joints or actuators. The fit is level (`no_icp` in swarmlrmc_veh.json). The kit's fused hull was split by `tools/art/v3/veh_prep.py` (swarmlrmc_prep.json). The wheels (`wheel_l0`..) are OWN GEOMETRY (`make_wheel`: tyre drum, recessed rim, hub boss, bolts) on axles fitted to the kit's wheels, which were cut from the hull; this own geometry is part of the CC BY-SA 4.0 derivative. Welded at 3 mm and planar-dissolved at 3 degrees, collapse only above 80k faces a part (no collapse on the shell-soup Hunter route; these hulls are clean). HALF-TRACK kit (v1's `hull.stl` and `launcher.stl`, made from the SRM variant): one front wheel pair (under `steer_l0`/`steer_r0`) and rear belts (`track_l`, `track_r`: the faces within 120 mm of the closed belt path round the five track wheels; tread strip 2 x 205 mm), where MC2's swarm LRM carrier is a 6-wheel truck. Turntable `srmc_turret`, launcher rack `SRM_Pack` as the gun (`gun_pitch` [-25, 20] about its rear hinge, from the kit's raised rest pose); one launcher as in the original.

tracks_note: both belts share one tread strip (v0, v_len, belt_m): veh_lowpoly.py maps each belt's arclength modulo belt_m (2 link pitches) into it, track_l in the left half of the atlas strip, track_r in the right; v increases toward the rear on the visible ground run
